review_requirements.label: Prewritten statement: Technique
review_requirements.text: A duplex Doppler color flow ultrasound study was performed in the upright position with and without manual augmentation of flow and/or Valsalva maneuver, documenting the condition of the Choose an item. venous systems of the extremity, including the saphenofemoral junction, saphenopopliteal junction, great saphenous vein, small saphenous vein and perforator veins, as well as the precise location and extent of the varicosities to be treated. This study documents reflux as lasting more than 500 milliseconds in either the saphenous veins or the perforator veins.
